mobile_combined.label: Fine-tuned + geometry + colour + cosine, 30 epochs
mobile_combined.reason: Geometry, colour, cosine and extra epochs each increased mean camera-like accuracy on the fine-tuned controls, although several gains were noisy. Test the requested combination without claiming the effects add up.

mobile_frozen_combined.label: Frozen + geometry + colour + cosine, 30 epochs
mobile_frozen_combined.reason: Freezing was the strongest initial strategy. Test the same requested recipe while preserving the frozen backbone. The augmentation/schedule effects under freezing are not isolated by this combination.
